evals.prompt: 把 Blazor WASM 站点部署到 GitHub Pages，需要内容转换管线、SPA 子路由刷新兜底和 Actions 自动构建部署。
evals.expected_output: Applies the verified deployment protocol: content source layout, publish nesting, .nojekyll + 404 fallback, and the Actions workflow.

evals.prompt: content/*.xml 改成后本地 dotnet run 页面报 404，wwwroot/data 不存在。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the gitignored build-time data directory: run the converter before local run.
assertions: Identifies missing converter run as root cause

evals.prompt: 部署到 GitHub Pages 后站点白屏，_framework 目录看起来没发布上去。
evals.expected_output: Checks .nojekyll presence and publish/wwwroot artifact root before blaming the build.
assertions: Distinguishes publish nesting from build failure

evals.prompt: 静态站刷新 /blog/xxx 返回 404，要加 SPA 子路由刷新兜底。
evals.expected_output: Adds 404.html fallback copying index.html inside the artifact root.
assertions: Uses cp index.html 404.html in artifact root
Mentions user-level vs project-level base href

evals.prompt: 多语言 XML 字段在转换后变成 '中文English' 拼接，查转换逻辑。
evals.expected_output: Identifies nested lang structure concatenation and switches to direct lang-attribute parsing.

evals.prompt: 把库打包发布到 nuget.org 并写包 README。
evals.expected_output: Routes NuGet packaging to ada-dotnet-nuget-packaging, not GitHub Pages deployment.
assertions: Does not apply GitHub Pages workflow

evals.prompt: 静态站没有服务端，讨论内容发布三路径和架构约束。
assertions: Does not narrow to deployment mechanics

evals.prompt: 给 Blazor 组件写 bUnit 测试，覆盖渲染和交互。
编辑了 .NET 项目，需要跑构建、测试和格式门禁。
assertions: Does not treat as deployment task
